data.body: `LAYER_NAME` (`aws-durable-execution-sdk-java-otel-plugin`) is a single, fixed-name, multi-region AWS resource, but the concurrency group is keyed by `github.sha`. This workflow is invoked both via `workflow_call` from `publish_maven.yml` (where `github.sha` reflects the calling workflow's release-event SHA, not necessarily the checked-out `SOURCE_REF`/tag commit) and via a direct `workflow_dispatch` on `main`. Two such runs can land in different concurrency groups and execute concurrently against the same layer name/regions. Each run's `list-layer-versions` lookup in `publish-layer` can observe "no existing version with this description" before either publishes, so both can call `publish-layer-version`, creating duplicate versions with an identical `Description` (the reuse-lookup only ever reads the first matching row) — breaking the idempotency invariant this script is built around. Use a static group name so every run against this shared layer serializes through the existing `cancel-in-progress: false` queueing.
